data.body_html:
The 2042 F1 Grand Prix weekend in Marbella is set to be one of the most exhilarating events on the Costa del Sol. With the race drawing thousands of fans, a yacht charter offers the ultimate vantage point — away from the crowds, with your own private deck, bar, and skipper. Our fleet of 17+ boats departs directly from Puerto Banús, making it effortless to combine luxury with the thrill of Formula 1. Whether you want a 2-hour spin or an all-day cruise, every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on our Tier A boats.

Below, we break down the best boats, pricing, and logistics for the 2042 F1 weekend. For any yacht not listed with a fixed rate, just send us a WhatsApp message.

Why charter a yacht for the F1 Grand Prix weekend?

Marbella’s coastline offers prime F1 viewing. From the water, you can anchor near the circuit or cruise alongside the action. A private yacht means no queuing, no packed grandstands, and full control over your schedule. The Mediterranean in May (average 22–25°C) is ideal for sunbathing between practice sessions. Plus, you get the full hospitality package: cold drinks, snacks, and a dedicated crew.

All yachts depart from Puerto Banús. Here are the top choices for groups of 5 to 12 guests:

For smaller groups, consider the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax). For speed lovers, the Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) or Bandido (11.5m, 8 pax) are excellent.

Pricing breakdown for the F1 weekend

We have two fixed-price tiers. All other boats require a custom quote via WhatsApp.

  • Tier A (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39): €749 for 2 hours, €1,299 for 4 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours. Includes skipper, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT.
  • Tier B (Mangusta 80 white & grey): €4,719 minimum 4 hours. Includes a free jet ski. Skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT included.

All other yachts (e.g., Azimut 58, Ferretti 94, Lagoon 380) are priced on request. Message us on WhatsApp with your preferred dates and group size.

What’s included in every charter?

No hidden costs. Every booking includes:

  • Licensed skipper
  • Fuel for the entire charter
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21% VAT)

You can bring your own food or order catering. Just let us know in advance.

How to book for the 2042 F1 Grand Prix

Spaces fill quickly for big events. To secure your yacht:

  1. Choose your preferred boat from the list above.
  2. For Tier A or B, use the pricing table to calculate your cost.
  3. For all other yachts, send a WhatsApp message with your dates, group size, and any special requests.
  4. We’ll confirm availability and send a booking link.

We recommend booking at least 4–6 weeks in advance for the F1 weekend.

Best spots to watch the F1 from the water

From Puerto Banús, you can cruise to several prime locations:

  • Puerto Banús marina – anchor near the entrance for a lively atmosphere.
  • Marbella coast – find a quiet bay like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés.
  • Near the circuit – the skipper can position the yacht for a direct view of the track.

The Mangusta 80’s free jet ski adds extra fun for exploring between races.
